lines.en: I walk along the wall, away from the lamps.
My nails scrape the night-time bark.
I drift closer along the smell of blood.
My shadow slides along the ground.

lines.zh: 我的血鬼术慢慢铺开了。
lines.en: My Blood Demon Art is spreading.

lines.zh: 我缩在树冠里等你经过。
lines.en: I tuck myself in the canopy and wait for you to pass.
I count the water drops on the eaves.
Night wind carries the smell of prey.
You stand in the moonlight; easy to find.

lines.zh: 下弦之陆的血鬼术，慢慢来。
lines.en: Lower Moon Six's art takes its time.

lines.zh: 日轮刀的伤，烧得我发疼。

lines.en: Water Breathing Squad, here to die
Do not walk so close to my sleeve.
Lower Moon Six — don't press so close.

lines.zh: 你体内流动着我的血液！
lines.en: Your veins flow with my blood!
Feel the power of my blood magic!
I tuck this broken blade into my sleeve.
Your life will belong to me!
My Blood Demon Art, tucked in my sleeve.
My blood, you'll never drink enough!
A Demon Slayer's footsteps are close.
In the sun, you have nowhere to run!
Feel the taste of blood magic!

lines.zh: 我的血鬼术已经铺开了。
lines.en: My Blood Demon Art is already spread out.
I know that Demon Slayer uniform.
My Blood Demon Art gathers in my throat.

lines.zh: 你的日轮刀先暴露了你。
lines.en: Your nichirin blade gives you away.

lines.zh: 无惨之血在我体内发烫。
下弦之陆，前来取你性命。
lines.en: Lower Moon Six comes for your life.
My claws will tear you apart!

lines.zh: 你一近身，我的爪子就到。
lines.en: Close the distance and my claws arrive.
I am the evil of the dark!
Feel the power of my blood!
The Lower Moon Six debt is unpaid.

lines.zh: 下弦之陆的血鬼术，先尝尝。
lines.en: Taste the Blood Art of Lower Six.
Before dawn, I have time to kill you.
I count the gaps in your breathing.

lines.zh: 血鬼术已经绕到你身后。
lines.en: My Blood Demon Art is already behind you.
The hand on your blade is shaking.

lines.zh: 我退到树影里，再扑出来。
lines.en: I slip into tree shade and lunge out.

lines.zh: 太阳还没升，你还有机会逃。
lines.en: Sun's not up; you still could run.

lines.zh: 我闻到你伤口结痂的味道。
lines.en: I smell your wound scabbing over.

lines.zh: 下弦之陆釜鵺，血鬼术已经备好。
lines.en: Lower Moon Six Kamanue — my Blood Demon Art is ready.
I circle the tree, waiting for your turn.

lines.zh: 每多流一滴血，我就更强。
lines.en: Every drop spilled makes me stronger.

lines.zh: 张开血盆大口，嘶吼着扑向猎物。
lines.en: Lunges at prey with a blood-curdling roar.

lines.zh: 挥动锋利的爪子，撕裂敌人的皮肉。
怒吼一声，近战攻击，无处可逃。
lines.en: Roars and attacks, leaving nowhere to hide.

lines.zh: 伸长獠牙，扑向鬼杀队成员。
lines.en: Lunges with long fangs at the Demon Slayers.

lines.zh: 咆哮着咬向对手，血花四溅。
lines.en: Bites with a blood-curdling roar, splattering blood.

lines.zh: 嘶吼着跳起，用利爪攻击。
lines.en: Jumps with a roar, attacking with claws.

lines.zh: 怒吼着扑上前去，攻击近战。
lines.en: Lunges forward with a roar, attacking in melee.

lines.zh: 挥动利爪，撕咬鬼杀队队员。
撕咬敌人，享受猎杀的快感。

lines.en: My nails rake through the uniform.

lines.zh: 我一跃而起，从上方咬下。
lines.en: I leap and bite down from above.

lines.zh: 血鬼术缠住你握刀的手。
lines.en: My art binds the hand on your blade.

lines.zh: 你退到阳光边，我不敢追。
lines.en: You back to sunlight; I dare not follow.
I swing my severed arm at your blade.

lines.zh: 夜里我的伤口立刻合上。
lines.en: At night my wounds close at once.

lines.zh: 我拖着你的腿往阴影里拽。
lines.en: I drag your leg toward the shade.

lines.zh: 獠牙咬进肩膀，血溅出来。
lines.en: Fangs sink into your shoulder; blood sprays.

lines.zh: 在夜晚的荒野中悄然出现。
lines.en: Appears silently in the wilderness at night.

lines.zh: 夜晚的幽暗之地，它开始行动。
lines.en: It moves at night in dark places.

lines.zh: 我从屋檐的阴影里垂下来。
lines.en: I lower myself from the shadow of the eaves.

lines.zh: 夜晚，荒野中浮现它的身影。
lines.en: Appears in the wilderness at night.

lines.zh: 月黑之夜，我从林间站起。
lines.en: On a moonless night I rise from the woods.

lines.zh: 无惨的血把我从土里叫醒。
lines.en: Muzan's blood wakes me from the soil.
In the wilds I open demon eyes.

lines.zh: 我避开灯火，在暗处成形。
lines.en: I shun lamplight and take shape in shadow.

lines.zh: 下弦之陆的名号在夜里响起。
lines.en: The name Lower Moon Six sounds at night.
